text: Process Canvas ports (emits, dataFlow, channels, parentMemberId, stage) are declarative-only: the agent still applies the label at runtime, and graph edges are derived from these ports — so dropping a port entry corrupts the model/graph without necessarily changing runtime routing.

Recovering interrupted prior-run work: a crashed/interrupted run may leave an issue's WIP in a git STASH (not only in the working tree or a bare branch) — run 'git stash list' before assuming work was reverted/lost. Note 'git checkout stash@{N} -- <files>' STAGES those files, so a later gh-as-agent commit of other work sweeps them in; unstash into a scratch area or reset the index if you need separate commits.
GitHub issues/tickets in 314092_agent-execution-environment are always authored in English, even when the requesting human chats in another language (e.g. German).

To integration-test a commit-making CLI's git behaviour (knowledge/gh-as-agent) without an ambient identity, run the real CLI as a subprocess inside a temp `git init` repo with a stripped identity: HOME=empty tmp dir, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM=os.devnull, and GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL popped from env.

When a CLI tool wraps a git commit, extract identity args into a pure `build_commit_args()`-style helper so unit tests can assert the inline `-c user.name/user.email` flags without running git; the integration test then runs the full CLI against a stripped-identity env to close the gap.

buildAgentClaudeMd has TWO call sites whose output must stay byte-identical — saveAgentPrompt (seed) and the /internal/agents/:id/prompt-preview endpoint; any new per-agent opt (skills, skillDescriptions, knowledgeDigestRef) MUST be threaded through both or the preview diverges from what's seeded.

When a prompt-assembly.js enrichment reads data from disk, the I/O helper belongs in orchestrator.js (fail-soft, try/catch per item) while the pure renderer in prompt-assembly.js stays fs-free and accepts the data as a caller-supplied map — see agentSkillDescriptions + skillsSection pattern in PR #618.

For AC6 (preview == seed) in CLAUDE.md composition features: both `saveAgentPrompt` and the `/internal/agents/:id/prompt-preview` endpoint must be updated to pass the same enrichment data to buildAgentClaudeMd — verify both call sites in every prompt-assembly PR.

When a dialog has single vs multi-item phrasing, use a derived boolean flag (e.g. `single = aggregated && count <= 1`) to branch copy only — leave controls, submit logic, and checkbox behaviour untouched; the flag is purely presentational.

When threading graph-node data from a section component into a dialog (e.g. teamSkills for extend-target picker), pass it as a second argument to the callback prop (onReviewSuggestion(s, skills)) and store it on the state object that opens the dialog — single source of truth, no separate fetch needed.

The skill.json startup backfill (and any bulk write to the GLOBAL skill pool) MUST live in admin-console, not the orchestrator: the orchestrator mounts /template-workspace (=/pool/skills) READ-ONLY, while admin-console mounts /pool RW. Both mount /workspace (team+agent skills) RW. So orchestrator can only stamp team-tier skills (_teamSkillDir) and agent dirs.

Two-sided module pattern (skill-manifest, knowledge-digest): when reviewing, run 'node --test' on BOTH test suites and verify byte-identical guard (test case that diffs the two files) passes — this is the only automated drift detector between admin-console and orchestrator copies.

skill-manifest.js copy semantics: stampSkillCopy (promote/lift/share) discards the cpSync-dragged skill.json before re-stamping (fresh v1 chain + origin); stampSkill (import, edit, create) reads any existing manifest and continues the chain — concept §3.1 / §3.5. Verify correct choice when reviewing any new copy-creating path.

Adding an optional field to the two-sided knowledge store (orchestrator/knowledge-store.js + agent-image/scripts/knowledge) stays JSONL byte-identical iff appended LAST in KEY_ORDER on BOTH mirrors and only emitted when a non-empty trimmed string; an absent field then serializes exactly as before, so the digest (reads text only) is provably unchanged. Assert with a 'field absent unless supplied round-trips identical' test on both the JS (node --test) and Python (test_knowledge.py) suites.

Route-level display overlay pattern in admin-console/api/api.js: compute read-time-only display fields (e.g. augmentDisplaySummary, sibling of augmentDigestInclusion) in the /api/knowledge/graph route AFTER the pure graph builder, so the pure builder stays entries+skills-only and never depends on LLM/heuristic display logic. Persist only authoritative values (real LLM summaries) via the canonical overlay in runConvergenceCollector/_serializeCanonicalKind, carried forward across convergence only while the entry text is unchanged (text edit -> regenerate).

When a new optional field is added to a two-sided JS+Python KB store, the KEY_ORDER, makeKnowledgeEntry/build_entry, and validateKnowledgeEntry must all be updated in BOTH mirrors and both cross-runtime GOLDEN tests must pass — no summary field emitted when absent means serialisation is byte-identical to pre-PR output.
